items.title: MSCI confirms Strategy's removal from indexes at end of November
items.summary: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI's final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

items.title: Stablecoin Drain, ETF Outflows Leave Bitcoin 'Running on Empty'
items.summary: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in 30 days, the fastest contraction since June 2022, amid weak ETF demand.

items.title: Strategy, Metaplanet lose MSCI index membership in November reshuffle
items.summary: Strategy had opposed MSCI's rules, arguing exclusion would harm its reputation as a neutral provider.

items.title: Bitcoin whales stack coins while ETF investors dump millions daily
items.summary: Glassnode's seven-day observations through November 9 show narrow accumulation, while completed ETF sessions through November 10 still record withdrawals.

items.title: MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30
items.summary: MSCI will take Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi out of its global indexes as of the Nov. 30 close.

items.title: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day
items.summary: Bitcoin continues to test support amid ETF selling.
